author: New China TV
description: UN Climate Change Executive Secretary Simon Stiell on Saturday urged negotiators to "move swiftly to the hardest issues and to avoid tactical delays" as the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) reached its halfway point.
title: UN climate chief urges swift action as COP31 reaches midpoint

author: New China TV
description:
Openness. Innovation. Cooperation. #APEC2026's priorities are also woven into the story of its host city, #Shenzhen.

From a border town to a global metropolis in less than half a century, Shenzhen offers a window into Chinese modernization.

Ahead of the #APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting, Xinhua's Miao Xiaojuan invites the people who call Shenzhen home to spell out what makes their city special.

A Miao Xiaojuan Studio Film
A Xinhua News Agency Production
title: Documentary | Shenzhen Through Our Eyes

author: New China TV
description:
Shenzhen is getting a floral makeover ahead of APEC 2026! Colorful flower displays are bringing fresh energy to the streets of the southern Chinese city as it prepares to welcome guests from across the Asia-Pacific. Take a look at Shenzhen in full bloom!
#Shenzhen #APEC2026 #China #Cityscape #Flowers
title: Shenzhen gears up for APEC meeting

description:

Discover the momentum of cross-Pacific connections at APEC China 2026!
title: #AmazingChina | The Pacific accelerates: New connections, shorter distances

description: From radio telescopes to satellite launches and joint academic programs, China and Thailand have steadily expanded their aerospace partnership in recent years, turning scientific exchanges into practical cooperation that benefits both countries and the wider Southeast Asian region.
title: China-Thailand space cooperation turns scientific exchanges into tangible projects

title: New findings further expose Japanese troops' wartime atrocities in China

description:
Tiny #tiger, BIG attitude! When you weigh 15 pounds but you're convinced you run the entire zoo.

Who do you think won this epic showdown? 😂

author: New China TV
description:
"It is the one forum in which the United States sits with China," U.S. scholar Sourabh Gupta highlights APEC's crucial role in fostering cooperation, especially in tackling transnational challenges.
The 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting will be held in Shenzhen on Nov. 18-19, focusing on openness, innovation, and cooperation. #APEC2026 #Shenzhen #GlobalTrade
title: U.S. scholar stresses APEC's crucial role in tackling transnational challenges

author: New China TV
description:
A sea of blooms -- inside Asia's largest flower market.

Every morning, #Dounan Flower Market in #Kunming, Yunnan Province in southwest China, bursts into life before the first deals are even struck.
Vendors stream in with carts overflowing with fresh blossoms, transforming the bustling market into an ocean of color and fragrance.
title: Trendy China | A sea of blooms -- inside Asia's largest flower market

author: New China TV
description: Eduardo Pedrosa, executive director of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Secretariat, said China's further opening-up, including in areas such as the digital economy and artificial intelligence (AI), would create new opportunities for deeper cooperation across the Asia-Pacific and joint efforts to address technological change. #GLOBALink
title: China's 3rd APEC hosting comes amid push for opening-up's next frontier: APEC secretariat chief

description: The 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit and Related Summits kicked off Sunday in Manila, the Philippines, with focus on topics including energy security, food security, transnational crime and transboundary haze pollution. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | 49th ASEAN Summit kicks off in Philippines

author: New China TV
description:
"Swan Lake" in reality! Flocks of white swans from Siberian region of Russia have touched down at a wetland by the Yellow River in Pinglu County of Yuncheng, north China's Shanxi Province, to spend the winter.
Covering over 6,000 hectares, the wetland has a pleasant climate and abundant food, serving as a major winter habitat for swans.
#WhooperSwan #MigratoryBirds #WildlifeConservation #ChinaNature #SwanLake (recorded)
title: Pinglu Yellow River wetland: Winter home for swans

title: SpaceX completes 15th Starship flight test, spacecraft caught by launch tower for 1st time

description: What makes an ordinary local market a must-visit destination for tourists from around the world? Welcome to Badaju Market in Zibo, Shandong, China!
